lcc_original: 亞當生了塞特之後，在世的日子還有八百年；這期間他還生兒養女。
notes: 生了: tags attach to 生 only; 了 is a Chinese aspect particle with no Hebrew equivalent (Rule 5)
{<WAH0853>} remains implicit — the Hebrew object marker אֶת has no explicit word in LCC just as in UNV (Rule 4)

UNV's 又在<WAH01961><WTH8799>世<WH03117> restructured in LCC as 在世的日子<WH03117>還有<WAH01961><WTH8799>: LCC fronts the subject phrase 日子 and places the copular verb 還有 after it, inverting UNV's word order; <WH03117> (יְמֵי, days) maps to LCC's 日子 rather than 世
LCC's 這期間他還 is an explanatory expansion (no Hebrew lexeme behind it) → left unannotated
